title: Part A short answer (2 marks)

criteria.name: Core statement
criteria.descriptor: Definition, difference or principle is correct and complete.

criteria.name: Supporting detail
criteria.descriptor: A concrete example from a real or given interface, or a labelled sketch.

deductions: Half mark off for a definition with no example where one is asked.
No marks for an unlabelled sketch.

title: Part B application / case question (10 marks; scaled for 13 and 15 marks)
appliesTo: Scenario-based design questions, critiques, research plans, wireframing, process explanations

criteria.name: Scenario and users
criteria.descriptor: Restates the given scenario, names the users and their context or constraints.

criteria.name: Diagram or artefact
criteria.descriptor: A labelled diagram or design artefact that fits the question: process loop, empathy map, wireframe, wireflow, research table, style tiles. Must contain scenario-specific content.

criteria.name: Concepts and method
criteria.descriptor: The right framework, principles or methods are named and correctly explained.

criteria.name: Application to the scenario
criteria.descriptor: Each concept is applied concretely to the given scenario with specific evidence, not restated as theory.

criteria.name: Justification and outcome
criteria.descriptor: Decisions are justified with criteria; the answer ends with how the design will be tested, measured or iterated.

deductions: Generic theory never applied to the scenario: application marks capped at 1.
A problem statement written as a solution: no marks for that step.
Diagram present but with no scenario-specific content: at most half the diagram marks.

title: Design project / case-study report (10 marks)
appliesTo: Course projects, e.g. 'redesign a campus service and test it with five students'

criteria.name: Problem framing
criteria.descriptor: Real users and context identified; problem stated as a user need with evidence.

criteria.name: Research evidence
criteria.descriptor: Appropriate methods used; findings synthesised (affinity map, personas, journey).

criteria.name: Design rationale
criteria.descriptor: Design decisions traced to research findings and UI/UX principles.

criteria.name: Prototype and usability evidence
criteria.descriptor: Prototype matches the red route; usability test run with tasks, metrics and findings; at least one iteration shown.

criteria.name: Reflection
criteria.descriptor: Limitations, accessibility considerations, what would change next.

deductions: Screens copied from existing apps without attribution: maximum 6/10.
